title: Rapid Fire
description: Hold left mouse button for automatic rapid fire
script:
-- Rapid Fire Script
-- Hold left mouse button to auto-fire

function OnEvent(event, arg)
    if event == "MOUSE_BUTTON_PRESSED" and arg == 1 then
        while IsMouseButtonPressed(1) and IsScriptRunning() do
            ClickMouseButton(1)
            Sleep(80)
        end
    end
end

title: Basic Combo
description: Execute a basic fighting game combo with one key press
script:
-- Fighting Game Combo
-- Press F1 to execute combo

function OnEvent(event, arg)
    if event == "KEY_PRESSED" then
        -- Combo: light punch, light punch, heavy punch, special
        TapKey("j")
        Sleep(100)
        TapKey("j")
        Sleep(100)
        TapKey("k")
        Sleep(150)
        TapKey("l")
        Sleep(50)
        TapKey("u")
        Log("Combo executed!")
    end
end

title: Auto Clicker
description: Auto click at fixed interval while holding right mouse button
script:
-- Auto Clicker
-- Hold right mouse button for auto clicks

function OnEvent(event, arg)
    if event == "MOUSE_BUTTON_PRESSED" and arg == 3 then
        Log("Auto clicker started")
        while IsMouseButtonPressed(3) and IsScriptRunning() do
            ClickMouseButton(1)
            Sleep(200)
        end
        Log("Auto clicker stopped")
    end
end

title: Bunny Hop
description: Auto jump when holding space and moving
script:
-- Bunny Hop Script
-- Automatically jump when holding space

function OnEvent(event, arg)
    if event == "KEY_PRESSED" then
        if IsKeyPressed("space") then
            while IsKeyPressed("space") and IsScriptRunning() do
                TapKey("space")
                Sleep(30)
            end
        end
    end
end

title: Recoil Control
description: Move mouse down while firing to counter recoil
script:
-- Recoil Control
-- Compensates for weapon recoil while firing

function OnEvent(event, arg)
    if event == "MOUSE_BUTTON_PRESSED" and arg == 1 then
        while IsMouseButtonPressed(1) and IsScriptRunning() do
            MoveMouseRelative(0, 3)
            Sleep(10)
        end
    end
end
